blindSummary: The “most protective” tier in the July 2026 assessment: state/provincial non-discrimination law covers gender identity, and shield/refuge protections are enforceable against actions brought from outside the state/province; no state/province-specific negative finding beyond the shared federal layer (passport and related identity-document policy, already reflected in the national baseline). No country-unique finding beyond insurance-coverage details a visitor never encounters. Clearly above the country-wide average.
